Hi, i've been running into an issue with the latest version of verso-slides where the message info traces appear in all black like so:

It seems this is because of a recent refractoring of CSS variables in verso#954 , and this change also seems to have broken syntax highlighting as the entire trace will get highlighted in `--verso-message-info-color. I had an LLM investigate and it came back with a couple of tiny patches in verso#973 and verso-slides#71 , which seem to fix the issue. If someone wants to take a look that would be awesome.

Has anyone else seen this issue or have any insight?
